Another issue is regulatory oversight. NASA, especially since Challenger, has become incredibly risk averse to the point that they're strongly inhibiting technological developments. For instance SpaceX wanted to retropulsive landings for the cargo (and crew) capsules (landing the capsules from the ISS similar to how they land their rockets), but NASA was hardly even willing to give the idea consideration instead favoring the decades old, and completely inflexible, approach of parachuting things down - typically into the sea.
